scope: Primary-source literature review plus two reproducible experimental extensions. No claim of exhaustive worldwide expertise or decipherment.
experiment_A: Correct phase-5 solver by making greedy CV/VC segmentation a hard feasibility condition on fitting-segment cipher adjacency. No use of held-out adjacency in fitting. Repair initial random keys by assigning a conflicting symbol a safe two-letter unit; reject any proposal that introduces a forbidden join. Recompute full objective and feasibility independently.
calibration: Only synthetic known-plaintext controls may select solver budget/temperature. Start with phase-5 budget, 8x60000 and temperature .002; retain failures. If needed, test a documented higher-temperature or soft-to-hard schedule on controls only. Need >=95% exact held-out units for each of two keys per model before real cases. Report held-out segmentation separately, without hiding failures.
real_plan: Reuse phase-5 32 configurations and their 32 within-segment nulls for direct comparison if all controls validate. Full frozen model settings and same leaf-separated data. No semantic selection of a key.
experiment_B: Descriptive adjacency diagnostics on strict word readings in ZL and IT, stratified by Currier A/B and section/hand where possible. Count identical adjacent words and distinct words at Levenshtein distance 1. Compare with within-page random permutations preserving line slots and word inventories. At least 100 fixed-seed permutations, multiple comparisons explicitly exploratory. Include textual and Naibbe controls when compatible, with artificial-layout limitation documented.
review: Distinguish primary material evidence, peer-reviewed analyses, proceedings, preprints and unsupported claims. Do not equate a publication title, low entropy, repeated words or a solved synthetic control with a real translation.
constraints: No invented glyph meanings, no semantic cribs from unconfirmed plants/stars, no silently forced alternatives. Image enhancement cannot supply absent ink. No claim of new physical, chemical or expert paleographic examination.
